test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 27 Mar 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Seven boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, and B7 are sitting in a row facing towards south (not necessarily in the same order). B7 is not the neighbour of B1. B3 is to the immediate right of B4 but is not the neighbour of B5. B2 sits at one of the extreme ends and is the neighbour of B4. Only two boys sit between B1 and B5. Which of the following position of B6 is correct?

options.text: Second to the left of B3
Second to the right of B5

solution:
**Given:** Seven boys B1, B2, B3, B4, B5, B6, and B7 are sitting in a row facing towards south.

1) B2 sits at one of the extreme ends and is the neighbour of B4.

2) B3 is to the immediate right of B4 but is not the neighbour of B5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8cb28a91e58430ebd8bb21d414f40bde2910860aa8d869887f22cc37e2bf6d7a.png] 

3) Only two boys sit between B1 and B5.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/003bee98bc972c7db3945ef8f577e5da169efb7c3a4d6036ceec4e0bdf155ef3.png] 

4) B7 is not the neighbour of B1.

After positioning B1 only one position is left which will be occupied by the only person left i.e. B6.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3b45fe860fbea2b30873b3d766cd8b4d84e033977ff4d50610607e8b84df3631.png] 

Thus, according to the final arrangement, B6 is immediate right of B1.

Hence, **"Option 2" **is the correct answer.
